issue.title: Unify Bob JSON-output option conventions while preserving existing flags
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-46.3 note #2; explicitly deferred in plan:202610/bob_command_tree.md. completion status and vault-sync status expose -j/--json, while task reconcile and many other leaves expose -f/--format json. Inventory JSON-capable public leaves, choose a consistent policy with Bryan, and migrate documentation, completion, and help while retaining every existing spelling and JSON payload. Internal capture protocol options may only grow additively. Scope is the JSON option convention, not renaming commands or changing output schemas.

task_type_fields.proposal: Adopt one consistent public JSON-output option policy across Bob commands, retaining compatible old flags and existing JSON schemas.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The approved command-tree epic only sections help, adds task/pomodoro routing, and migrates callers; its canonical-docs phase explicitly deferred R8 output-format option unification.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-46.3 note #2 records the explicitly deferred R8 JSON-option consistency recommendation. It changes a pre-existing cross-command policy, outside the completed namespace migration.
